attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Exactly two bipedal anthropomorphic animals with consistent functional paws or hands. Flat educational illustration, simple clean color shapes and smooth dark outlines, flat colors only, white-background context.
Use this precise Catalan storyboard. Each numbered prompt is a separate panel. Do not print any text.

1. A omple la galleda al sorral amb la pala. B aplana amb la mà una zona lliure per al castell.
2. A porta la galleda plena pel mànec fins al replà allisat. B hi posa la pala al costat.

Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is CANGUR, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is CONILL, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
Real physical toy sandcastle molding. One blue tapered bucket with a single handle, EXACTLY ONE mouth: wide circular open end. The narrow CLOSED end has four integrated concave corner cavities whose outside shape looks like four hollow raised square blocks on the bottom of bucket. P1 bucket stands mouth UP, those exterior square on bottom touch sand below, A fills through wide mouth. B pats sand next to it. P2 A carries upright full bucket, B is at flat area. P3 B holds bucket inverted, mouth now down pressed flat on sand and ABOVE the body we see the closed narrow end and four exterior squared bumps. P4 B lifts the same inverted bucket mouth down, those same outside four raised features still on top of bucket, while the sandcastle cast is visible on ground with same four merlons projecting at its top. Same red hand shovel placed on ground after first panel. No second bucket, no extra limbs. Backdrop white and sand below.
attempts.review: El motlle blau s’omple amb la boca oberta cap amunt; el conill el gira amb els merlets a dalt i l’aixeca amb el mateix perfil del castell acabat. La pala del fons no intervé en el relat.

alt.ca: El cangur omple de sorra una galleda amb forma de torre. El conill tomba i aixeca la galleda, i la torre queda dreta.
alt.es: El canguro llena de arena un cubo con forma de torre. El conejo vuelca y levanta el cubo, y la torre queda en pie.
